	<div class="wpb_text_column wpb_content_element " >
		<div class="wpb_wrapper">
			<h1>Holiday Apartments Punta Trettu | Kite House Sardinia</h1>
<h2>Accommodation with Swimming Pool near Punta Trettu and Porto Botte</h2>
<p>The holiday apartments of <strong>Kite House Sardinia</strong> are set in a beautiful garden with a lovely <strong>swimming pool</strong>.</p>
<p>All apartments feature one or two bedrooms, a <strong>living room</strong> with a fully equipped kitchen, a bathroom with shower and hair dryer, <strong>high-speed Wi-Fi</strong>, air conditioning, heating and a dehumidifier, plus a private veranda with hammock, table and chairs.</p>
<p>For your safety, each apartment is also equipped with a smoke detector, a carbon monoxide detector and a fire extinguisher.</p>

		</div>

class="wpb_wrapper">
	<div class="wpb_text_column wpb_content_element  vc_custom_1766075096085" >
		<div class="wpb_wrapper">
			<h3>Two-room Apartments &#8220;Palme&#8221;</h3>
<p>Two-room apartments with pool view, with one bedroom, living/dining room with fully equipped kitchen, bathroom with shower and hair dryer, high-speed Wi-Fi, air conditioning, heating and dehumidifier, and a spacious porch with hammocks and sofa. Sleeps up to 3 guests. Recommended for couples, friends, and families with small children.</p>

		</div>
	</div>
<div class="standard-arrow bullet-top"><ul>
<li>Size: 50 m²</li>
<li>Bed types: double and single</li>
<li>Rates: €40–€180 per night</li>
</ul>
</div>
	<div class="wpb_text_column wpb_content_element  vc_custom_1766222241634" >
		<div class="wpb_wrapper">

<span class="kh-amenity"><i class="fas fa-shower" aria-hidden="true"></i> Bathroom with shower &amp; hairdryer</span><br />
<span class="kh-amenity"><i class="far fa-snowflake" aria-hidden="true"></i> Air conditioning &amp; heating</span><br />
<span class="kh-amenity"><i class="fas fa-umbrella-beach" aria-hidden="true"></i> Porch / veranda with hammock</span><br />
<span class="kh-amenity"><i class="fas fa-bath" aria-hidden="true"></i> Bed linen &amp; towels</span><br />

	<div class="wpb_text_column wpb_content_element  vc_custom_1766075104190" >
		<div class="wpb_wrapper">
			<h3>Three-room Apartments &#8220;Eucalipti&#8221;</h3>
<p>Three-room apartments with two bedrooms, a living/dining room with a fully equipped kitchen, bathroom with shower and hair dryer, high-speed Wi-Fi, air conditioning, heating and dehumidifier, plus a terrace porch with hammock. Sleeps up to 5 guests. Recommended for families, two couples, and groups of friends.</p>

		</div>
	</div>
<div class="standard-arrow bullet-top"><ul>
<li>Size: 65 m²</li>
<li>Bed types: double and single</li>
<li>Rates: €50–€230 per night</li>
</ul>
</div>

class="wpb_wrapper">
	<div class="wpb_text_column wpb_content_element  vc_custom_1766075112011" >
		<div class="wpb_wrapper">
			<h3>Three-room Apartments &#8220;Ulivi&#8221;</h3>
<p>Three-room apartments with two bedrooms, a living/dining room with a fully equipped kitchen, bathroom with shower and hair dryer, high-speed Wi-Fi, air conditioning, heating and dehumidifier, plus a porch with hammock. Sleeps up to 5 guests. Recommended for families, two couples, and groups of friends.</p>

		</div>
	</div>
<div class="standard-arrow bullet-top"><ul>
<li>Size: 65 m²</li>
<li>Bed types: double and single</li>
<li>Rates: €50–€220 per night</li>
</ul>
</div>
	<div class="wpb_text_column wpb_content_element  vc_custom_1766222241634" >
		<div class="wpb_wrapper">
			<div class="kh-amenities kh-services"><span class="kh-amenity"><i class="fa fa-wifi" aria-hidden="true"></i> High-speed Wi-Fi</span><br />

<span class="kh-amenity"><i class="fas fa-shower" aria-hidden="true"></i> Bathroom with shower &amp; hairdryer</span><br />
<span class="kh-amenity"><i class="far fa-snowflake" aria-hidden="true"></i> Air conditioning &amp; heating</span><br />
<span class="kh-amenity"><i class="fas fa-umbrella-beach" aria-hidden="true"></i> Porch / veranda with hammock</span><br />
<span class="kh-amenity"><i class="fas fa-bath" aria-hidden="true"></i> Bed linen &amp; towels</span><br />
<span class="kh-amenity"><i class="fas fa-bed" aria-hidden="true"></i> Extra pillows</span><br />
<span class="kh-amenity"><i class="fas fa-broom" aria-hidden="true"></i> Cleaning products</span><br />
<span class="kh-amenity"><i class="fas fa-baby" aria-hidden="true"></i> Baby cot/crib (on request)</span><br />
<span class="kh-amenity"><i class="fas fa-chair" aria-hidden="true"></i> High chair (on request)</span><br />
<span class="kh-amenity"><i class="fas fa-sync-alt" aria-hidden="true"></i> Shared washing machine</span></div>

		</div>

class="wpb_wrapper">
	<div class="wpb_text_column wpb_content_element  vc_custom_1766075124289" >
		<div class="wpb_wrapper">
			<h3>Two-room Apartment &#8220;Melone&#8221;</h3>
<p>Two-room apartment with one spacious bedroom and a large living/dining room with a fully equipped kitchen, bathroom with shower and hair dryer, high-speed Wi-Fi, air conditioning, heating and dehumidifier, plus a porch with hammocks. Sleeps up to 6 guests. Recommended for families and groups of friends.</p>

		</div>
	</div>
<div class="standard-arrow bullet-top"><ul>
<li>Size: 75 m²</li>
<li>Bed types: double and single</li>
<li>Rates: €50–€210 per night</li>
</ul>
</div>
	<div class="wpb_text_column wpb_content_element  vc_custom_1766222241634" >

class="wpb_wrapper">
	<div class="wpb_text_column wpb_content_element  vc_custom_1766075213075" >
		<div class="wpb_wrapper">
			<h3>Studio Apartments &#8220;Datteri&#8221;</h3>
<p>Studio apartments with a mezzanine sleeping area and a living/dining room with a fully equipped kitchen, bathroom with shower and hair dryer, high-speed Wi-Fi, air conditioning, heating and dehumidifier, plus a ground-floor porch with hammock. Sleeps up to 3 guests. Recommended for couples, solo travelers and small families.</p>

		</div>
	</div>
<div class="standard-arrow bullet-top"><ul>
<li>Size: 35 m²</li>
<li>Bed types: double and single</li>
<li>Rates: €35–€140 per night</li>
</ul>
</div>
	<div class="wpb_text_column wpb_content_element  vc_custom_1766222241634" >

<span class="kh-amenity"><i class="fas fa-shower" aria-hidden="true"></i> Bathroom with shower &amp; hairdryer</span><br />
<span class="kh-amenity"><i class="far fa-snowflake" aria-hidden="true"></i> Air conditioning &amp; heating</span><br />
